vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: deepvista-vistabase-card
Version: 0.1.0-alpha.18

The skill provides a standard interface for managing knowledge cards via the `deepvista-cli`. It includes explicit safety instructions (using [!CAUTION] blocks) for the AI agent to confirm write and destructive operations with the user. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the functionality is consistent with the stated purpose of a knowledge management service.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a CLI-based

dimensions.detail: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper around the 'deepvista' CLI for managing cards; requiring the 'deepvista' binary (and providing an install that creates it) matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only invoke the deepvista CLI subcommands (list, get, create, update, edit, delete, search, etc.), require user confirmation for write/delete operations, and do not reference unrelated files, system paths, or extra environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install uses a 'uv' package (deepvista-cli) which will place a 'deepvista' binary on PATH — this is expected for a CLI skill but carries the usual moderate risk of third‑party packages (verify the package provenance and integrity before installing).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no env vars itself, which is proportional. Authentication and credentials are delegated to deepvista-shared (referenced in metadata) — review that sibling skill to understand what secrets/credentials will be required.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not forced-always, does not request system-wide configuration changes, and does not declare elevated privileges; autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other concerning flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for controlling DeepVista cards via the deepvista CLI. Before installing: 1) verify the deepvista-cli package source (uv registry) and the project's homepage (https://cli.deepvista.ai); 2) inspect the deepvista-shared skill to see what credentials or auth flows it requires and ensure they are minimal and appropriate; 3) be cautious when approving write/delete actions and prefer explicit confirmation (the SKILL.md instructs this); 4) if you have strict supply-chain policies, consider running the deepvista binary in an isolated environment or reviewing its code/release artifacts first.
